mapper.select: SELECT equipment_id AS equipmentId, user_id AS userId, network_type AS networkType, equipment_type AS equipmentType, model_name, serial_number, seq, status, acquisition_cost, acquisition_date, remark FROM TB_EQUIPMENT WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY seq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EQUIPMENT ( equipment_id, user_id, network_type, equipment_type, model_name, serial_number, seq, status, acquisition_cost, acquisition_date, remark ) VALUES ( #{equipmentId}, #{userId}, #{networkType}, #{equipmentType}, #{modelName}, #{serialNumber}, #{seq}, #{status}, #{acquisitionCost}, #{acquisitionDate}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EQUIPMENT SET equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, network_type = #{networkType}, model_name = #{modelName}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, status = #{status}, acquisition_cost = #{acquisitionCost}, acquisition_date = #{acquisitionDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_date = NOW() WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
